recognize_zh: c-MYC 蛋白在大多數腫瘤細胞核呈中到強度陽性，估計遠超過 40%，只有少數細胞核為藍色陰性；MYC 高表現提示需進行 FISH 檢查 MYC 重排，但蛋白表現不等於基因重排。
features: Nuclear MYC staining of moderate to strong intensity in the large majority of tumor cells (well above 40%)
Minority of blue unstained nuclei, including small background cells and endothelial cells
Medium to large nuclei with round to oval contours arranged in diffuse sheets
Blood vessels with erythrocytes serve as internal negative structures
describe_en: MYC immunohistochemistry shows moderate to strong nuclear staining in the large majority of neoplastic cells, visually well above the 40% threshold used to define MYC protein overexpression, with only a minority of unstained nuclei. The positive cells form diffuse sheets around small vessels. High MYC protein expression, particularly when combined with BCL2 expression, defines a double-expressor phenotype and should prompt FISH; in this case FISH confirmed MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Double-expressor lymphomas show MYC (40% or more) and BCL2 (50% or more) protein by IHC but lack gene rearrangements on FISH.
Burkitt shows near-100% MYC nuclear staining with BCL2 negativity.
Most DLBCL, NOS show MYC in a smaller fraction of cells below 40%.
